name: @nivo-web-lite/nivo-web
description: The NIVO Web workspace (the web-hosting company's six agents) authored with the nivoos SDK, with its own CRM provider `nivoweb-crm` that reaches this repository's CRM service (be/). The build writes ONE seed document the dev deploy applies. Slice 1: the Support agent (Hỗ trợ), the brain and the CRM provider.

scripts.build: nivoos package build src/nivo-web.package.ts --out seed && prettier --write seed
